title: A Trail for the Wreck
author: Paloma Thackeray
blurb: Dominic Yarrow, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. But when the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source before the monsoon makes landfall.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
